privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.law25_text: You have the right to access your data, export it, correct it and request its deletion. VNK Automatisation complies with the Quebec privacy law.
privacy.export_text: Download a complete copy of your personal data in JSON format (profile, sessions, security events, activity logs, API access). Right to data portability.
privacy.hosting_partners: Partners used: Stripe (payments), Dropbox (storage), Railway (hosting). All data transfers are governed by confidentiality agreements.
privacy.analytics_text: Lets VNK improve the portal via anonymized usage metrics.
privacy.marketing_text: Announcements of new features, automation tips, quarterly newsletters.
privacy.consents_footer: Changes are recorded in your activity history. You can modify these choices at any time.
privacy.delete_text: Request the permanent deletion of your account and associated data. In accordance with the privacy law, a super-administrator will process the request within 30 days.
privacy.delete_warning_text: Some data must be kept by legal obligation (invoices, tax audit) for the duration imposed by Quebec law and the federal Income Tax Act.
privacy.delete_modal_description: Type your email to confirm the request.
privacy.delete_modal_footer: Once recorded, the request will trigger a notification to all super-administrators. You will receive a confirmation email with the processing timelines.
